title: Fence 'Em In
statementMd:
You want to create a zombie farm. Luckily you've recently stumbled upon a zombie spawner. However, you can't break the spawner to move it elsewhere, so the farm needs to be built around it. Additionally, to trap the zombies in, you need to build a fence around the spawner.

However, due to the new update, the farm requires a very specific type of fence. The fence needs to be a non-degenerate triangle with vertices at 3 of $N$ pre-determined fence posts, located on a 2d grid. If needed, the spawner can lie directly on the fence.

To give the mobs more space to spawn (maximizing profits), you want to make the area enclosed by the fence as large as possible. What is the largest possible area that such a fence can enclose, if one exists?

## Input

The first line of input is the integer $N$ ($3 \le N \le 50000$): the number of fence posts in the grid. The second line has two space-separated integers, $g_x$ and $g_y$ ($-5000 \le g_x,g_y \le 5000$): the coordinates of the spawner. The next $N$ lines each contain two space-separated integers, $x_i$ and $y_i$ ($-5000 \le x,y \le 5000$): the coordinates of the $i^\text{th}$ fence posts.

## Output

Output a single floating point value: The maximum area enclosed by a triangular fence containing the spawner, and with vertices at $3$ of the given fence posts. If no such triangular fence exists, output -1.
statementZhMd:
你想建造一个僵尸农场。幸运的是，你最近偶然发现了一个僵尸刷怪笼。然而，你无法破坏刷怪笼并将它移到别处，因此必须围绕它建造农场。此外，为了把僵尸困在里面，你需要在刷怪笼周围建造一道围栏。

然而，由于最近的更新，农场需要一种非常特殊的围栏。围栏必须是一个非退化三角形，三个顶点必须选自二维网格上预先确定的 $N$ 根围栏柱。如有需要，刷怪笼可以恰好位于围栏上。

为了给怪物提供更多生成空间（从而使收益最大化），你希望围栏围成的面积尽可能大。如果存在满足要求的围栏，它能围成的最大面积是多少？

## 输入格式

输入的第一行是整数 $N$（$3 \le N \le 50000$），表示网格中围栏柱的数量。第二行包含两个以空格分隔的整数 $g_x$ 和 $g_y$（$-5000 \le g_x,g_y \le 5000$），表示刷怪笼的坐标。接下来的 $N$ 行，每行包含两个以空格分隔的整数 $x_i$ 和 $y_i$（$-5000 \le x,y \le 5000$），表示第 $i^\text{th}$ 根围栏柱的坐标。

## 输出格式

输出一个浮点数，表示包含刷怪笼且顶点选自给定围栏柱中的 $3$ 根的三角形围栏所能围成的最大面积。如果不存在这样的三角形围栏，输出 -1。
